means the same thing as अर्धजरतीय; vide तन्त्रब्राo p. 720 on जै. III. 1. 13. It means 'it involves a total contradiction to say that one would cook half a hen for food and keep the other half for laying eggs.'
Vide महाभारत on वार्षिक 5 on पा. IV. 1. 78 ( अर्ध जरस्याः कामचोदयेति), शाङ्करभाष्य on जै. सू. I. 2. 8 ( यथार्धार्थि सह शाखीयोर्थः प्रतिपन्नो न तथार्धजरतीयं लभ्यं), परा. मा. II. 1. p. 702.

Resembles अर्धजरतीयन्याय. Vide तन्त्रवा. pp. 170, 174, 180, 261; शाङ्करभाष्य on जै. सू. III. 3. 18. वैशस means 'destruction, rending into pieces, conflict'. The कुमारसम्भव IV. 31 employs the word in the literal sense.

जै. II. 3. 3 and XI. 4. 10. Vide H. of Dh. vol. III, p. 38 and above pp. 1332–33 n 2201-2, शाङ्करभाष्य on जै. सू. III. 3. 50.
इमामगृभ्णन्नशनामुतरस्यामुत्ताराधिपीन्यागवे—तै. सं. V. 1. 2. 1 and the mantra occurs in तै. सं. IV. 1. 2. 1, explained in श्री. म्या. म. p. 80, अर्थसंग्रह p. 5. Vide p. 1308 n 2147.
vide दुस्पृष्टीका on जै. IV. 4. 1 p. 1270. This is put forward to assert that in राजसूय the conventional meaning has to be taken and not the literal one.
vide तन्त्रवा. on जै. I. 3. 12 p. 236 (यस्तस्मलूद्यवादयुद्दनिमावपरिगृहात्। पदं कर्तुं सम्वेिदैत स हग्याव् व्योम मुदिसि), शाङ्करभाष्य on जै. सू. II. 1. 18.

शाबर on जै. I. 4. 25, अर्थसंग्रह (p. 16, calls it अ न्याय), श्लोका. (on चौवनासूत्र verse 47 p. 59), तन्त्रवा. on जै. II. 1. 1 p. 378 (शाङ्करः सर्वभावानां तादृशोपख्या स्वभावतः । तेन तानां वदनपर्थान् मनुहि प्रत्ययवादप: II). Vide p. 1291 note 2111 above.

जै. VI. 4. 22; तँ. आ. III. 7. 1. 7-8 ह्यस्योभयं ह्यविरातिमात्स्यैन्- येत्. Here the word उभयं is अविवक्षित and is no part of the विधि.

VI. 4. 22 p. 1438, on VII. 1. 2 p. 1526, on IX. 1. 1 p. 1636, on X. 3, 39 p. 1882 (उद्दिष्टमानस्य च संस्था न विवक्ष्यते प्रद्येत्व) and स्म. प्र. pp. 45-46, 90, 132, 210 and निबंधस्थ on या. जै. I. 4. 1–2. उन्दिष्ट्र, चित्रा, अग्निहोत्र are names of yāgas (and not गुणाविधि) and are प्रमाण. Vide pp. 1244-45 n 2021-22 above.
If the उपक्रम is doubtful it is the उपसंहार that settles the same and not vice versa. Vide भामती on ये. धृ. III. 3. 17.

जै. III. 1. 26-27; उपसंहारेण नाम सामान्यतः प्राप्तस्य विशेषो सहोपरूपो व्यापारविशेषो विधिः। मी. न्या. प्र. p. 261; vide निता. on या. I. 256, जै. मि. pp. 37 and 71, स्म. प्र. p. 111 and the present author's notes to V. M. p. 179.

This refers to the verse यथार्तुलिङ्गानि नानारूपाणि पर्याये। द्यदृश्यन्ते तानि सान्वये यथा भावा द्युगादिवृ ॥ आविपर्वे 1.39 (= cr. ed. I. 37), शातिकर्म 210. 17 (= cr. ed. 233. 15). This verse is quoted by सन्त्र्या. on जै. I. 3. 7 p. 202, in शाबरभाष्य on दे. धृ. I. 3. 30. It is also नाट्यपुराण 9. 65, विष्णुपुराण I. 5. 61, मार्केण्डेय 45. 43–44.

जै. II. 1. 46. Vide M. M. Jha's 'Pūrvamīmāmsā in its sources' pp. 192–193 for explanation and examples and H. of Dh. vol; III. p. 443 note 744 and pp. 1297–98 n 2123 above. बिन्दुरूप on या. III. 248 exemplifies this न्याय. The word एकवाक्यता occurs in जै. III. 4. 24.
m. by सन्त्र्या. on II. 1. 12 p. 415. It is the same as अवषान्याय above.

Vide pp. 1309-10 notes 1251-52 on ऐन्द्रया गार्हपत्यमुच्यते.

If a man's name is औदुम्बरी one at once infers, without being expressly told, that he is the son of one called उद्रेमेष. Vide शाबर on जै. III. 5. 26 p. 1003 and on II. 3, 3 at p. 580 and सन्त्र्या. p. 580.
जै. I. 2. 19-25 concerning तँ. सं. II. 1. 1. 6 ओदुम्बरो धूमो भवति, ऊर्जो उदम्बर ऊर्ध्व पश्चाः, सन्त्र्या. p. 352, मी. न्या. प्र. p. 134 ff.
जै. X. 5. 1, explained in मलमाससत्र p. 779.

शाबर on जै. VI. 2. 19-20 on ‘न कालञ्ज भक्षयेत्’ says that this is downright prohibition ( प्रतिषेध ) and not a पर्युदास. Vide मी. न्या. प्र. pp. 248-249 and निश्चित्तप. p. 6.

This occurs in the पू. मी. सू. XII. 2. 34 itself ( अधिकच गुणः अजबदुक्त्रयेऽपि ): शंबर explains ‘क्षिप्रप्रस्य कांस्यपात्रभोजिनिव यमः। यदि तयोरेकस्मिन्पात्रे भोजनमापद्यते, अक्षुरुत्पापि शिष्पक्षय धर्मो नियम्येत मा मूद्र्मलोप इति”.
Vide सुपदीका p. 1388 on जै. VI. 2. 1. Some actions such as counting the hair on the skin of an ass or the teeth of a crow are useless or profitless.
Vide तन्त्रवा. p. 198 on जै I. 3. 7, मेषा. on मनु VIII. 1, स्मृ. स. p. 534, स्मृ. स. p. 95 and notes thereon at p. 135.
शाबर on जै. V. 2. 3 pp. 1310-11. Vide H. of Dh. vol. II. pp. 739-740, vol. IV. pp. 441-442 note 987 and पदार्थानुसमय below.
तन्त्रवा. p. 245 on जै. I. 3. 16. The qualities of, the cause are found in the effect.
जै. VII. 3. 1-4. Vide आप. श्री. 23. 10. 6 ff and H. of Dh. vol. IV. pp. 136-137 n 312 for references and p. 1307 above.

Vide तन्त्रवा. p. 268 on जै. I. 3. 24. ( कुश is दुर्बर्ष and काश is a grassy plant with white flowers ). These are so frail that no one can support himself by means of these; so metaphorically it means “supporting by frail or hopeless arguments.” Vide स्मृ. स. p. 527.

Taking up a purely hypothetical point for discussion; occurs frequently in Śābarabhāṣya, e. g. on जै. VI. 8. 43 p. 1522 ( कुत्सा चिन्तायां प्रयोजनं वक्तव्यम् ), on XI. 3. 16 p. 2175, XII. 2. 11 p. 2242; vide तन्त्रवा. p. 287 (on जै. I. 3. 27) and p 890 on जै. III. 4. 1 ( पशु भाष्यकारे णोपंन्यस्तः कुतः स कुलायचिन्तान्यायेन ).

The word is derived from किहुत्, used in such passages as in काठकुमारी ‘गर्गोरल ... शक्किलं खेति महतीर्थं खलवर्णपरंपरां, सवीविनथाजामामेवैकल ज्येथामापवनं किहुतं समावःः’  Vide स्मृ. स. p. 241 and present author's note on p. 419 of the notes to स्मृ. स.

जै. VI. 4. 17-20. If the Purodāśa to be offered in बार्हपूर्णमास is partially burnt, still one should perform the rite with the unburnt part of the cake and a prāyaścitta would be necessary only if the whole purodāśa is burnt. Vide मिताक्षरा on या. III, 243.
Meaning ‘like all pigeons, young and old, simultaneously alighting on a threshing floor.’ Vide शाबर on जै. XI. 1. 16 p 2111, मी. न्या. प्र. p. 65.
Same as देषींष्पन्याय above. Vide शाबर on जै. III. 2. 3 and अर्थसंग्रह p. 6. .
जै. II. 2. 25-26 based on वृज्जनेन्द्रियकामसूत्र (तै. ना. II. 1. 5. 6), the meaning being वृषिकरणत्वेनेन्द्रियं भावयेत्. Vide मी. न्या. प्र. pp. 42-43, and 36-39 and p. 1310 above.
This is part of जै. III. 3. 9 (गुणमुख्यव्यतिक्रमे सवर्थ्या-मुलयेन वेदसंयोगः). Vide तन्त्रवा. pp. 810 and above p. 1290 n. 2108; काठूरं भाष्य on दे. सू. III. 3. 33 quotes this sūtra.
This is जै X. 2. 63. The words क्रिया स्यात् (or भवति) are to be understood.

In such a sentence as गाव आनीयन्तां बलीवदोच, the separate mention of balivardas that are really included under ‘gāvah’ is due to the fact that bulls are more intractable than cows and require special attention and effort. This is often used in Dharmaśāstra works. Vide मिता० on या. III. 312-313, स्मृतिच. (on व्यवहार) pp. 66, 67, 102, 169, 280, 300, कुल्लुक on मनु VIII, 28, व्य. म. p. 2 and H. of Dh. vol. III. p. 926 note 966.

Vide शबर on जै. III. 2. 1. This न्याय is also cited as मुख्यगौणयो: ... संप्रत्यय: शाङ्करभाष्य on बे. सू. IV. 13. 12 cites it. मुख्य and गौण respectively mean ‘primary sense’ and ‘secondary sense.’ The महाभाष्य has the परिभाषा ‘गौण ... संप्रत्यय:’ on वार्तिक 1 on पा. I. I. 15 and on वार्तिक 4 on पा. VI. 3. 46. Vide H. of Dh. vol. III. p. 725, note 1399.
जै. III. 1. 13-15 based on वृक्षापविजेण ग्रहै संस्था (तै. सं. III, 2. 2. 3). Vide H. of Dh. vol. II. p. 589 note 1380 and above p. 1285-86 and n. 2098.
जै. III. 1. 26-27. Vide मी. न्या. प्र. p. 261, अर्थसंग्रह p. 24. Vide vol. IV, p. 670 n 1517.

Vide शबर on जै. I. 4. 23 (यथा छत्रिणो गच्छन्तीत्येकन छत्रिणा सर्वे लक्ष्यन्ते), सम्रवा. on I. 4. 13, p. 347, सुष्टुटीका on जै. IV. 4. 1 p. 1270 and VII. 3. 7, p. 1552 and H. of Dh. vol. II. pp. 500-501. शाङ्करभाष्य on दे. सू. III. 3. 34 employs it in explaning सतै विपन्नतो (कठोप. III. 1).
This appears like a विधि, but it is only an अर्थवाद for praising पयणेहोषि. The vedic passage is in तै. सं. V. 4, 3, 2 and जै. X. 8. 7 deals with it. भासली on बे. सू. III 3. 18 relies on it.

जै. IV. 3. 38-39 on तै. सं. II. 2, 5 रैथ्याभर हारूकपाले निर्णयते जुवे जाते. Though the performer of the rite is the father, the fruit accrues to the son that is born. Vide मिता. on या. II. 56 and III. 220, माष. वि. p. 18, स्वध. प. p. 253-54, हर. मी. p. 136 (Anan. ed,)
जै. IV. 3. 1 based on passages like वषप एर्णमपी छात्रपति न स पायं श्लोकं स्तुगोति (त सं. III. 3. 7. 2). Such sentences are not फलविधि, but merely अर्थवाद.

Vide तन्त्रवा. p. 860 (सृषि भाषाषेणयो दीर्णं वियवाो भेतरेषु), ष्कोक्न्य. (बचवाद, verse 15). If only the words सृषि दीर्णं वियवाो were uttered, कोपिरुष्व being a ब्राह्मण would be included; but if the whole sentence be used he would be excluded from the first part. The महाभाष्य frequently cites this nyāya, e. g. on वार्तिक 4 on पा. VI. 1. 2 and वार्तिक 1 on पा, I. I. 47 and on वार्तिक 2 on पा. VI. 2. 1; vide मिता. on या. III, 237 for this maxim.

जे. I. 4. 4 (तत्कश्यं याज्ञनज्ञागम्), which means तत् पुरुषार्थम् सर्वं पापकर्म्म अध्यायाच्च भवति. In ते. सं. I. 5.9.1 we read अग्रिहोत्रं क्षमो परिमितम्) and not a शुभविधि. Vide मी. न्या. प्र. p. 64, धर्मतर्जनिर्णय p. 3, अर्षसंराह pp. 4 and 20.

जे. I. 4. 5. The example is श्येनेनाभिचरन् यजेत. Here the word श्येन (meaning ‘hawk’) is applied to the rite called śyena, because it resembles the bird in its swift action. Vide मी. न्या. प्र. p. 238 (तेज यन्द्यथ्यायुपपश्येति यावत्) and p. 1245 above.

This is very often employed in कर्मशास्त्र works. Vide विश्वरूप on या. I. 147 and III. 257, मिता. on व्यवहार pp. 142, 146, 242, 249, 283, 296, 301, 315, 326, डायभाग X. 30, डायत्तस p. 170, स्य. स. p. 131 (and my notes on the same at pp. 221-222). For the derivation of वृण्ढापूपिक, vide अलङ्कारसर्वस्व on अर्थापत्ति p. 196 and जयस्थ thereon.

जे. VIII. 4. 1, तन्त्रवा. p 115 on जे. I. 2. 7, मी. न्या. प्र. p. 149. In this compound word होम is the principal word and the word द्वधि is उपसर्जन (or अप्रधान). Therefore द्वविंहोम् is the name of a rite.

Vide प्रायश्चित्तप्रकरण of भवदेव p. 18, प्राय. विवेक p. 81, द्वदिहलक्ष pp. 240-241. There is a व्रत on the 10th tithi of the bright half of Jyeṣṭha called दशाह्रा, since it removes ten sins. The maxim means that in certain cases, by a single performance one may be able to secure several objects.

Vide शबर on जे. IX. 3. 3 p. 1745, on जे. X. 2. 23 p. 1835 and on X. 2. 34 p. 838, मी. न्या. प्र. 201, एकादशतिष्र्म p. 89, भारती on ये. सू. III. 3. 14 and H. of Dh. vol. III. p. 837 n 1628 and above p. 1260 note 2051.

देहळी door-sill. A lamp thereon sheds light inside the room as well as outside. This is the same as प्रासाददीपन्याय below. प्रदीपपदम् occurs in जे. XI. 1. 61; vide शबर thereon, स्य. स. p. 149 explaining पा. II, 139 employs it.
जे. VII. 3. 19-25; Relied upon and explained in Mit. on Yāj. II. 135, डायभाग XI. 5. 16 p. 194 and स्य. स. pp. 500-502 and 535; vide H. of Dh. vol. III. pp. 704-705 note 1347a for explanation.
जे. VII. 4. 7 (in which the words यथा घेनुः किशोरण occur); शबर explains it clearly. घेनुः ordinarily means ‘cow’, but किशोर means in कृष्णिणकिशोर घेनुः, घेनु means ‘mare’.
जे. X. 8. 5 and XII. 1. 7. सौ refers to आज्यभागी; vide व्यवहारसार p. 231 (part of वृत्तिसंग्रह). द. मी p 182 and above p 1249.

means that it is not permissible to hold that in a विधिवाक्य a word therein has a meaning other than the direct one. The कल्पतरु on भारती (on ये. सू. I. 1. 1 p. 10) explains ‘विधायक शब्दे परो लक्षः शब्दार्थो न भवति’; vide शबर on IV. 4. 19 (which says अदृहणार्थे ष लक्षणा स्य्यं न विधो) and also on IV. 1. 8, where the ten यज्ञाधुध (स्य्य wooden sword etc.) mentioned in ते. सं. I, 6. 8. 2-3 are held to be an अनुसनाव and not a विधि. Vide परा. मा. I. 2. p. 298 and सह. पा. p. 372, स्यस्य. मी. p. 180.

Vide शाबर on जै. II. 1 p. 376, तन्त्रवार्तिक. on जै. I. 2. 7 and on III. 3. 11 p. 818. This is an old न्याय. वार्तिक 16 on पा. I. 1. 50 is संप्रयोगेण ह्या नह्यादृष्टचवद्भवत् and the महाभाष्य explains 'तत्राप्यो नह्यो समाधि एयो युष्टिः उभौ संप्रयुज्यवादे इति।'. मेधा. on मनु V. 51 and भामती on I. 4. p. 108 mention it. The idea is दृष्टैरेतरोपकारकत्व.

term: न हि निन्दा निन्द्यं निन्दितुं प्रयुज्यते, अपि तु विधेयं स्तोतुम्
explanation: vide H. of Dh. II. p. 581 n 1359 and above p. 96 n 237 for passages from Sabara and Tantravārtika. The मिता. on या. III. 221 paraphrases it.

term: न हीकरूपं शब्दस्यानेकार्थता सत्यौ गतो न्याय्या
explanation: Vide शाबर on जै. VIII. 3. 22 and IX. 4. 18 and the न्याय ‘अन्यायश्चानेकार्थत्वम्’ above p. 1339.

This is often expressed in the form नागृह्यमाणविशेषणानां in शाबर on जै. VII. 2. 13) or as न ब्राह्मणादीशे विशेषणे विशिष्टं केचन प्रत्ययेमर्हन्ति (as in शाबर on जै. I. 3, 3 p. 304). Vide तन्त्रवा. pp. 304, 326, 916, एका. तत्त्व p. 15, स्मृतिरत्न p. 313, व्य. म. p. 89 (and the present author's notes thereon pp. 117-118).

This न्याय occurs very frequently in शाबर and धर्मशास्त्र works in different forms, but the meaning is the same viz. 'there is nothing too heavy (i. e. impossible to prescribe) for a sacred text.' Vide शाबर on जै. II. 2. 27 (किमिह हि वचने न कुर्याज्ञास्ति...भाष्यः), on जै. III. 2. 3, X. 5. 11; the wording is ' न हि वचनस्य किंचिदालभ्यं नाम'. शङ्करभाष्य on बे. सू. III. 3. 41 and III. 4, 32 employs it. Vide विश्वरूप on या. I. 58 (referred to in H. of Dh. vol. II. p. 525 n 1224), मिता. on याज्ञ. III. 298 (H. of Dh. vol. IV. p. 66 n 161, परा. मा. II. 1 p. 202 and II. 2 p. 64).
Similar to आर्थाधिकरणन्याय. Vide विश्वरूप on या. III. 212.

जै. VI. 2. 27-28 and 29. Such passages as जुहोति स्क़न्ने जुहोति really lay down that whenever such a निमित्त as breaking occurs a fresh homa has to be performed. Vide मेधा. on मनु XI. 220 (एतत्प्रमुख्यावस्था &c.) and मिता. on या. I. 81.
जै. VI. 1. 51-52. Vide H. of Dh. vol. II. p. 46, vol. IV. p. 24 n 58 and above pp. 1295-96 and n 2121. It is employed by परा. मा. I. 1. p. 49, प्राय. सि. p. 132, व्य, म. p. 112.
नि. सि. p. 67 states that rules about श्राद्ध on a solar eclipse apply by analogy to श्राद्ध on a lunar eclipse.

This is expressed in the half verse 'प्रक्षालनाद्धि पङ्कस्य दूरादस्पर्शनं वरम्', introduced by विश्वरूप on या. I. 210 with the words तथा च लौकिकाः. This half verse is धनपर्व 2. 49, which reads श्रेयो न स्पशर्नाद् गुह्याद् धर्मार्थी यस्य विनयेहा वरं तस्य निषेहिता. शाङ्करभाष्य on बे. सू. III. 2. 22 quotes it.
जै. I. 3. 5-7 on the place of आचमन in view of the words वेदो कृत्वा नेर्दि कुर्यात् and explained by शाबर on I. 3. 7.
जै. V. 2. 1-2 and vide काण्डसङ्गम above p. 1342.
This is like 'silence shows consent'—Vide वृह. मी. p. 82 and H. of Dh. vol. III, p. 669 n 1264 and शाङ्करभाष्य on बे. सू. II. 4. 12.

जै. III. 6. 1-8; certain passages like यस्य पर्वमयी छुद्रभवति व यस्य पर्वं क्लोर्णो भवति occur in जै. सं. III. 5. 7. 2 without express reference to any topic. They are to be applicable to the modifications. Vide मी. व्या. प. 117 and भामती on जै. I. 1. 4 pp. 123-124.
जै. IV. 1. 11 and दुष्टपूर्वीका pp. 1203-5 on the Vedic text यो घीधिशो वट्टपोलीय पंचुमालभते. The emphasis is that both एकत्व and पुलत्व are to be insisted on.
जै. XII. 1. 1-6; vide प्रायश्चित्तप्रकरण of भवदेव p. 20, भाष. वि. p. 85 and गोविन्दानन्द's तत्वायकौमुदी on the latter and n 2205.
Occurs in Śabara's Bhāṣya on Jai IX. 2. 3, XII. 2. 16, सूत्रचर्चा. I. 2. 31 p. 147. पिष्टपेपण — Means grinding what is already well ground and therefore unnecessary repetition ( of arguments).
Literally means 'bending the back again and again to observe each of many objects lying on the ground.' Vide शाबर on जै. II. 1. 32 and तन्त्रवा. thereon p. 434. The मिता. on या. III. 216 employs it.

Vide शाबर on जै III. 4. 12 p. 922 and on जै. XI. 1. 22 p. 2013, तन्त्रवा. on जै. II. 1. 1 p. 380, III. 1. 12 p. 674, III. 4. 12 p. 902, III. 7. 10 p. 1080. It occurs in the महाभाष्य on वार्तिक 2 on पा. III. 1. 67. Vide above pp. 1235-38 n 2010.
जै. VI. 3. 13-17, स्मृतिचन्द्र. (on भाद्र p. 460). It means कृतद्रव्या पचारे द्रव्यान्तरे प्रतिनिघाय प्रयोगः कर्तव्यः.
Vide the न्याय 'निमित्सावृषो' etc. above, मिता. on या. III. 263-64 and 288 for this form of the न्याय.
मी. न्या. प्र. p. 47. The first part of the interpretation of जै. II. 1. 1 by Śabara is so called and the 2nd part is called भावार्थाधिकरण.
शाबर on जै. III. 3. 14 p. 844; परा. मा. I. 1. p. 391 illustrates it.
जै. X. 5. 1 and 6 (on which शाबर says ये कामवणस आरब्ध– व्यास्ते प्रथमावृषूपकम्पितमिव), तन्त्रवा. on जै. III. 2.20 p. 772 and on III. 4. 51 p. 988, व्य. म. p. 134.
Lit. ‘Crushing the principal wrestler’, the idea being that lesser champions would be regarded as vanquished if the principal wrestler is vanquished. Vide शाबरभाष्य on जै. I. 4. 28 and II. 1.12.
Vide दुष्टीका on जै. VII. 1. 2, p. 1526 and the न्याय ‘उदिरेपमानस्य’ etc. above.
Vide श्लोका. (सम्बन्ध्याक्षेप verse 55 p. 653 quoted above on p. 1179 n 1917.

जै. III. 2. 11-15 referring to the direction in वर्षापूर्णमास ‘सृक्त्वाकेन प्रस्तरं प्रहरति’ (the priest casts the bunch of kusa grass called *prastara* into the fire to the accompaniment of Sūktavāka mantras, which thus becomes an aṅga). For प्रस्तर, vide H. of Dh. vol. II, p. 1013 and for सृक्त्वाका हन्प H. of Dh. vol. II, p. 1073 n 2398.
same as दधिवीपीयन्याय. Vide शाबर on जै. XII. 1, 1 and 3.
Vide सब्र. on जै. II. 1. 12, p. 415. It refers to the example cited by शाबर on जै. I. 3. 8 'सत्र कैचिदीर्यञ्जयोदु यवशब्दं प्रयुञ्जते कैश्चिलिङ्गवद्भू ।'

In जै. IV. 4. 34 (which is a lengthy sūtra) we have the words तदुपसृष्टमुपलक्षणं चफलवत्सं तद्संनिधायुक्तं तदङ्गं स्यात्? Vide शाबर on जै. IV. 4. 19; कुल्लूक on मनु II. 101–102 employs it and so does the Śānkara-bhāṣya on V.S. II. 1. 14. Vide H. of Dh. vol. IV. p. 481 n. 1082.

जै. III. 2. 1. शाबर cites the mantra बर्हिर्दैवतं वदामि {I cut off barhis as an abode for the deity) and remarks that the mukhya sense is to be taken and not gauṇa ( secondary sense, based on similarity ).
Vide तककौडिन्यन्याय above p. 1343. The भिज्ञ. on भा. III. 257 refers to it.

शाबर on जै. II. 1. 43 has 'हतो ब्राह्मणो भोज्यस्तामिति परित्राजका इति'. The भामती on बे. सू. III. 1. 11 states that this nyāya means the same thing as गोबलीवर्दन्‍याय. The शाङ्गकरभाष्य mentions it on बे. सू. I. 4. 16, II. 3. 15, III. 1. 11. Vide सुबोधिनी on या. II, 96 (ed. by Mr. Gharpure).
मेधा. on मनु VII. 35 employs it. वसिष्ठ also was a brāhmaṇa but he may be separately mentioned as he was most eminent in tapas.
जै. II. 1. 1. मी. न्य. प्र. p. 128 and p. 1236 n 2010 above.

शावर frequently mentions it as on जै. II. 1. 4, III. 4. 40, IV. 1. 18, VI. 1. 1, IX. 1. 9. The सुदूदीका on जै. IV. 1. 18 explains 'भूतं द्रव्यं भव्यं क्रिया निर्दिद्यवतीति क्रियातोऽङ्गम्'. व्य. म. p. 111 mentions it; vide the present author's notes thereon pp. 173 ff and H. of Dh. vol. III, p. 695 n 1322.

based on जै. XII. 2. 22 (विमतिपिवद्‌धर्माणाम् असमवाये भूयसी स्यात् सधर्मेत्वम्). When there is a composite sacrifice comprising several rites the various details of which present conflicts the procedure to be adopted is such as to secure the performance of the details common to the largest number; this is relied upon in स्तुतिज्ञ. (on भाष्य p. 498) and व्यव. नि. p. 202.

जै. VI. 3 20. The rule is that if a substance prescribed for a sacrifice cannot be had, a similar substance may be used (as पूतीक for सोम mentioned by Sabara on Jai. VI. 3. 14); but where a substance is expressly forbidden it cannot be employed as a substitute, even when it is similar to the one prescribed. If mudga pulse cannot be had māṣa pulse cannot be used, as Tai. S. V. 1. 8 declares māṣa grains to be unfit for sacrifice. Vide भिज्ञ. on पा. II. 126, सूत्रभाष्य XIII. 16 (In both this nyāya is mentioned), भाष्य. तत्व p. 482, व्यव. म. p. 555.
same as गार्हपत्यीण्याय (जै. III. 1. 23).

जै. III. 1. 22. and शाबर thereon and नह्न. पा. p. 89. A gunavākya (clause laying down a subsidiary matter) is not to be taken as subsidiary to another gunavākya, as both are subsidiary to the main purpose and are of equal status. There are two rites viz. Agnyādheya.

term: झाबर on जै. III. 2.1. Vide above गौणमुख्ययोष्य etc.
जै. VI. 3. 1-7; vide H. of Db. vol. III, p 373 and above pp. 1163-64, धर्महेतानिनिर्णय p. 105, एका. तत्त्व pp. 18, 25.
जै. I. 3. 9 and above p. 1293 note 2116.
पश्नोभयोः पर्वागेदोषां न तमेकश्रोत्रों भवति or यवोध… नासावेकं पक्षं निवर्ययति or यवोध... नासावेकस्य वाक्यः
explanation: Vide झाबर on जै. VIII. 3. 7 and 14 (pp. 1616, 1619) and X. 1. 25 p. 1816.

q by न्यायसूत्रा (p. 1076) on तत्त्ववा. III. 1. 27 as बुद्धटोक; तत्त्ववा. p. 744 has यस्य ... सम्बन्ध इति न्यायपात. Vide above p. 1298 n 2124. This न्याय is employed also in works on Poetics, e. g. the व्यक्तिविवेक-व्याख्या p. 39 (TSS) and by अभिनवभारती on नाट्यशास्त्र (G. O. S. vol. I. p. 210 ‘ तथापि यस्य येनार्थसम्वन्ध इत्युक्तेश्चादरेत्तयो न शब्द इति').

Vide झाबर on जै. V. 4. 11 (पाव… के न तत्र न्यायः क्रमते) and on V. 3 12 (पाव... कं न सहस्रमुपसंक्रामति). The idea is; in the case of an authoritative text that much only is to be accepted as covered by it which is expressed by the words used and that it should not be made applicable to other cases on the ground of similarity or analogy. Vide सन्द्रवा. on जै. III. 5. 19, भामती on वे. IV. 1. 4 and on IV. 3. 4; मेधाए on मनु X. 127 applies this maxim. Vide H. of Db. vol. II. p. 469 n 1101.

One and the same word in a vidhi cannot be taken to have been used at the same time in the primary sense as well as in the secondary sense. Vide जै. III. 2 1 and झाबर thereon, व्य. म. p. 92 and notes there on by the present author (pp. 129-131), झाबभाब III. 30 p. 67 and H. of Db. vol III, p. 725 note 1399 and above pp. 1292-93 notes 2112-14.

term: जै. IV. 3. 27-28. The ज्योतिर्होस does not simultaneously bring out all the rewards but only one after another. The word occurs in sutra 28 itself and चोर्गसद्धि
explanation: means पर्योंय according to झाबर. Vide मेधा. on मनु XI. 220, दृतितत्त p. 239 (for explanation), माघ. वि. p. 78 and माच. प्रकरण की भबबेय (p. 18).
Vide जै. VI. 1. 44-50, मी. न्या. प्र. p. 113 and above p. 1290 n 2110 and परा. मा. I. 1. p. 48.
जै. IV. 3. 17-19 and H. of Db. vol. IV, p. 602 note 1367. and द्रष्ट. मी. p. 207, भामती on शाङ्करभाष्य on ब्रे. सू. I. 1. 4 p. 111 as part of the Pūrvapakṣa.

This means that the conventional meaning of a word is to be preferred to the etymological meaning as in the case of the word ‘rathakāra’ in Jai. VI. 1. 44 ff.; vide परा. मा. I. I. p. 300. As against this one must note another nyāya sometimes relied upon viz. यौगसम्बन्धे परिभाषाया अनुक्लत्वात् (used by the मिता. on या. II. 143 about the meaning of the word दीधिति). Vide H. of Dh. vol II. p. 780 n 1508 and the मी. न्या. प्र. pp. 112-113.
Vide शबर on जै. I. 1. p. 7 and I. 4. 2 p. 324.

जै. III. 8. 25-27. In दर्शपूर्णमास the adhvaryu priest recites ‘समश्र्व वर्षो विहेवेष्वस्ति’ (मै. सं. I. 4. 5). The reward, however, goes to the sacrificer and not to the adhvaryu, as the latter works for a fee.
जै. I. 4. 6-8. In the sentence वाजपेयेन स्वाराज्यकामो यजेत, वाजपेय is the name of a yāga and does not lay down any detail about a sacrifice; mentioned in Mit. on Yāj. I. 81.

जै. III. 1. 23. Tai. S. II. 5. 2. 5 lays down that the Vārtraghni and Vṛdhanvatī verses are recited on Pourṇamāsī and the Amāvāsyā These two are prescribed in relation to sacrifices that require the recitation of two anuvākyās. There is only one anuvākyā at the Darśa or Paurṇamāsī rite; therefore these verses cannot be used in Darśapūrṇamāsa. But two anuvākyās are known to be used in the subsidiary offerings in Darśa-Pūrṇamāsa. Therefore, the two anuvākyās ‘Vārtraghni’ and ‘Vṛdhanvatī’ are to be connected with Ājyabhāgas alone and not with the principal rite.
Vide above pp. 1239-40 note 2015; द्वादशम II. 30 (स्वर्गवरं क्षिप्रदं ... न विकल्प:) remarks ‘कर्तव्यपदममप्राप्तार्थम्’. This is a विधि, though there is no word expressing exhortation.

जै. IV. 3. 15-16. Where no fruit or reward is expressly prescribed for a sacrifice svarga is the reward. This is so with the Viśvajit sacrifice in which the sacrificer had to donate all that he owned at the time of the sacrifice; mentioned by मेघा. on मनु II. 2, परा. मा. I. 1 p. 148, एका. तत्त्र p. 23.
Vide शबर on जै. I. 2. 29, IV. 4. 19 and the न्याय ‘न विधौ परः शब्दार्थः’ above. मलमासतत्त्व (p. 760) relies on this.
जै. I. 4. 13-16. वैश्वदेव is the first parvan of the four parvans of Cāturmāsyas. It is a name {nāmadheya} and not a guṇavidhi. It is employed in the बृह. मी. p. 239.
Vide जातेष्टिन्याय.
जै. II. 4. 8-33. It is the same as सर्वेषामात्मत्वपरपर्याय below.
Vide झाबर on IV. 1. 23, IV. 1. 46, IV. 2-30.
जे. X. 8. 6; vide above p. 1249 and 2030 on अतिरात्रे षोडशिनि गृह्णाति and नातिरात्रे... गृह्णाति, अर्थसंग्रह p. 24.

जे. IV. 3. 5–7. The word संयोगपृथक्त्व occurs in जे. IV. 3. 5 itself; vide above p. 217 note 217; मेघा. on भहु II. 107, परा. मा. I. 1. 60, प्राय. तत्व. p. 474, एका. तत्व pp. 29–30, तिथितत्व p. 44, नि. सि. p. 84.

Vide झाबर on जे. XI. 1. 28 and XII. 3. 10; employed in एका. तत्व p. 32 and उदाहृतत्व p. 133; it is mentioned in the महाभाष्य on बार्तिक 4 on पा. VI. 1. 84. This nyāya has a limited application and often the maxim निमित्तसङ्गतौ etc. (i. e. repetition) applies.
Vide दायभाग III. 29–30 p. 67, महु. पा. p. 369, accepted in 6 Cal. 119. 126 (F. B.) and in L. R. 41 I. A. p. 290 at pp. 303-4.

This is the पूर्वपक्षसूत्र in जे. X. 3. 53-55, but it is held generally applicable unless there is a special or express provision for unequal distribution. This is followed in मिता. on याज्ञ. II. 265, दायभाग IV. 8 p. 80 (on स्त्रीधनविभाग), स्मृतिच. (II. pp. 152 and 285), कुल्लूक on महु III. 1. (सर्वं स्याद्भूतत्वादिति न्यायेन प्रति- द्वादशवर्षाणि व्रताचरणम्), परा. मा. I. 2. p. 362, मदनरत्न (on व्यवहार) p. 204.

जे. III. 6. 9. Passages like सतदश सामिधेनीषूच्यम् in Ait. Br. I. 1 that occur without being attached to any particular sacrifice are applicable only to vikrtis and not to the model (prakrti) sacrifice; vide मिमा. on या. I. 256.
जे. III. 4. 17 based on Tai. S. II. 6. 10. 1–2 which prohibits threatening or striking a brāhmaņa. Vide H. of Dh. vol. III, p. 515 note 937-938 and प्राय. तत्व p. 479, प्राय. वि. p. 6.
Vide यथाशक्तिय्याप and एका. तत्व pp. 18. 26.

जे. II. 4. 8–33. Vide H. of Dh. vol. III, p. 870 note 1693, vol. IV. pp 89–90 note 211, pp. 453–55 note 1011 and मिता. on पा. III. 325, अपरार्क p. 1053, स्मृतिच. (I. p. 5), महु. पा. pp. 11 and 91, भुजिक्षतत्व pp. 378, 380 and above p. 1273 and 2074.

Vide झाबर on जे. VII. 3. 16 (बाध्यते च सामान्यं विशेषेण) and तन्त्र. रत्ना. p. 1030 on जे. III. 6. 9 ‘तत्र नाम विशेषेण सामान्यस्य निराक्रिया। श्रप्यको यत्र सम्बन्धो विशेषेण प्रतीयते। तुल्यप्रमाणको हि विशेषो बाधको भवति न दुर्बल- प्रमाणकः’ and p. 1120; vide for examples स्मृतिच. (on व्यवहार pp. 142, 299, 381) and परा. मा. I. p. 233.
जे. I. 4. 25. Vide above p. 1291 note 2111.
जे. V. 1. 14; vide above pp. 1315–16 and 2164 and स्मृतिच. (on व्यवहार p. 297), सुबोधिनी (on पितरों) on p. 72 (text) and p. 183 (tr. by Mr. J. R. Gharpure).
जे. I. 2. 1 and 7; vide p. 1284 and झाबर on जे. II. 2. 6 and on III. 1. 18 (on आनर्थक्यतदङ्गैषु). अनर्थक means either 'meaningless' or 'purposeless'.

जै. III. 4. 20-24. In जै. चा. II. 2. 4. 6 there is a passage not connected with any specific sacrifice viz. सुवर्णं हिरण्यं धार्यम् (one should wear bright gold). This is a puruşadharma and not a sarvaprakaraṇa-dharma. Vide मिश्रा. on चा. II. 135-136, where this is used as an argument against the view that all wealth is for yajña.

Vide जै. III. 2. 16-19 and प्रस्तारमहरणण्याय (p. 1346) for the meaning of सूक्तवाक and प्रस्तर. In these sūtras it is established that the whole सूक्तवाक is not to be recited in both Paurnamāsa-iṣṭi and Darśa-iṣṭi, but only those portions of it that refer respectively to the deities of the two iṣṭis.

The word स्थालीपुलाक occurs in Jai. VII. 4. 12 itself; vide भाष्य on जै. VIII. 1. 11 and तन्त्रवा. on जै. III. 5. 19 p. 998. The महाभाष्य knew it since it says on वार्तिक 15 to पा. I. 4. 23 'पर्याप्तो ह्येकः पुलाकः स्थात्या निदर्शनाय'.
Fixing a post firmly in the earth by frequently pushing it down and about; occurs in शाबरभाष्य on जै. VII. 2. 1 and शास्त्रभाष्य on जै. छू. II. 1. 34 and III. 3. 53.
जै. VI. 1. 1-3, referred to in H. of Dh. vol. IV. p. 169.
जै. I. 2. 26-30. Vide H. of Dh. vol. III. p. 676 and notes 1276–77, सिद्धान्त on पा. III. 263, महामासंख p. 760 for application.
जै. I. 3. 15-23. Vide above p. 1281 n 2093 for explanation.
